    • setName

      public void setName(String name)

      Sets the name of this directory. Per the Apple Pascal documentation:

      A diskette's volume name must be seven or fewer characters long and may not contain an equals sign (=), dollar sign ($), question mark (?) or comma(,).

      This method only errors if, after applying the rules, the string is empty.

    • deleteFile

      public void deleteFile(FileEntry fileEntry)
      Delete a Pascal file. Pascal does not mark a file as delete, it simply removes the entry. This logic copies all data after into this position. Note that, regardless, any existing PascalFileEntry objects are invalid since their offset will be incorrect.
      Specified by:
      deleteFile in interface WritableDirectory
      See Also:
      • Capability.DELETE_FILES
